purpose: Synthetic localhost gate for the actual integrated server, separate from deployment/human evidence.

server.isolation: One dedicated Node child per configuration; development server on 4093 stays untouched.

workload.motionRoute: Actual slide/validPosition geometry, actual server-projected lounge arrival z (recorded per controller) and x in [-2,2]; send only while Socket.IO connected. Controller schedules are staggered evenly across the 100ms period to avoid artificial synchronised bursts. Readable controllers are single-flight: do not send while an earlier motion ACK is outstanding. Preserve both the minimum 80ms send interval and 80ms after the actual ACK, with the existing nextSend += 100 deadline. Apply accepted local route pose/direction only after an actual successful ACK from the same socket/control generation. Rejections remain counted rather than advancing optimistic pose. Deliberately paused controllers retain stationary 10Hz sends even while ACKs are outstanding; that fault workload is not throttled by the readable single-flight rule. Recorded achieved per-controller rates must stay 9.8..10.2Hz; no invalid fast burst is silently discarded. Before TCP pause the existing motion ACK drains; the slow controller continues valid stationary 10Hz frames during suppressed reads, then resumes route walking. These frames still run actual authority/geometry/dirty-tick/broadcast handlers. Reconnect motion waits for actual successful house.subscribe ACK and current generation; a transport-level connected flag alone cannot confer control. Bootstrap/subscribe handshake is outside ready-controller input time.
workload.intents: One stable UUID and actual houseId per command, original lounge zone/current generation; alternate chat.send/card.save every 10s, rotate authors. Card ID/revision from actually received state.
workload.slowReader: Pinned Engine.IO WS.ws -> ws.WebSocket._socket. ws.pause sets _paused and calls actual TCP readable pause; verify isPaused and no snapshot deliveries. Transport read suppression, not callback delay.
workload.slowSchedule: At t=15s and every 300s pause 65s. Wait through heartbeat disconnection and 30s control lease expiry; same-token fresh socket rejoin verifies latest durable cursor, new control generation and Quiet. Under-1800s calibration pauses at t=5s for <=8s, with no expiry claim. Version2: calibration durations100..1799 seconds exercise one complete65-second pause/heartbeat/lease-expiry/rejoin cycle per reader at t=15s; durations<100 keep the brief no-expiry calibration. Full1800-second runs retain six cycles per reader.

measurement.visibility: For each saved scheduled intent target every view of that house, including paused/disconnected slow readers. Monotonic send-to-actual-snapshot time with snapshot.durable.sequence >= receipt.sequence. Catch-up is included in overall p95/separate slow metrics. Missing delivery fails.
measurement.server: Child RSS/monitorEventLoopDelay. Runtime-only Server.prototype.attach wrapper captures real Socket.IO server without replacing handlers. Actual Engine.IO writeBuffer/ws.bufferedAmount sampled every 100ms; unseen instantaneous peaks are not established by sampling.
measurement.eventLoopThresholdNote: Architecture specifies bounded/stable event loop without numeric threshold. 50ms p95/100ms p99 are predeclared local diagnostic criteria.
measurement.acceptanceAccounting: For 1800s require exactly180 saved intents per house, max scheduled-intent interval <=11s, twelve healthy final views and observed peak12, zero unexpected disconnections outside deliberate slow-reader pauses/teardown, six complete expiry/rejoin cycles for each of two slow readers. Achieved connected-time motion cadence alone cannot hide lost views. Actual /health must return ok at both startup and after drain before fixture teardown.

rejectedFrameDiagnostics.scope: First 32 actual rejected-motion replies or unexpected non-paused ACK timeouts. Deliberately paused expected timeouts remain aggregate counters and do not fill rejection traces. Count dropped trace entries.
rejectedFrameDiagnostics.privacy: No actor IDs, session cookies, controller tokens, invitation codes, coordinates or chat/card content. Complete bounded server rejection messages are retained.
rejectedFrameDiagnostics.outstanding: Separate readable/normal and deliberately paused outstanding maxima; combined value remains for historical comparison.

acceptance: Exact fixture/duration >=1800s each, numeric bounds, complete delivery, no unexpected normal motion rejection/ACK timeout, all slow readers expire/rejoin. Short runs remain CALIBRATION.
retention: Only sanitised aggregate results/evidence committed. Raw server logs/databases/cookies/codes/identities stay ignored under .local. No production credentials read. Completed full runs append immutable entries to full-history; original L1/L2 failures also stay in separate original.results.json files. Retained v1 harness/protocol bytes stay ignored .local. Version2 protocol and complete generator/backend source/results/history are preserved before version3 changes. Labelled pacing-v3 outputs must not overwrite earlier results.
externalLimits: No Fly machine or /data volume exercised
No physical network impairment, phone/IME, human trial/preference or academic-value proof

pacingRefinement.scope: Generator-only pacing/ACK route-state refinement; app/realtime/geometry/dependencies and all acceptance gates unchanged.
pacingRefinement.attributionLimit: Actual frozen callback/handler replay proves feasible compressed-arrival overlap. V2 aggregates lack timing/messages, so neither the original one nor 29 rejections are attributed to this path.

sourceCalibration.method: AST-extract actual unchanged/candidate motion callbacks and execute actual realtime handler transpiled from installed TypeScript. Inject only clocks, transport and synthetic authority; no duplicated pacing/server policy.
cases: Baseline sends at100/200ms while first ACK pending; real handler receives at200/201ms and emits movement-specific RATE_LIMITED.
Candidate sends once while pending; waits>=80ms after ACK; does not commit local pose before successful ACK; normal60s cadence remains9.8..10.2Hz.
Ordinary readable motion remains10Hz with2ms ACKs and zero rejects.
Deliberately paused stationary motion retains10Hz with suppressed ACKs and growing paused outstanding count.
Not-ready/disconnected/preparing-pause views do not send; stale-generation ACK cannot mutate current pose/lastAck.
Unchanged server still rejects excessive walking speed and compressed non-stationary movement; general action-rate negative control remains distinct.
Actual trace recorder retains at most32 safe entries, reports dropped entries, and keeps normal/paused outstanding metrics separate.
sourceCalibration.candidateDisqualifiers: Stop if paused stationary workload changes, ordinary cadence falls outside9.8..10.2Hz, rejection/timeout/count/view/generation/expiry gates fail or backend source changes.

liveCalibration.label: pacing-v3
liveCalibration.classification: CALIBRATION, not sustained/full acceptance; fullDuration remains false and deliberately paused-reader combined p95 remains included.
liveCalibration.command: mise exec -- node tools/house-load.mjs --duration 100 --config L2 --port 4098 --label pacing-v3
liveCalibration.nextFullRun: Parent inspection/review and explicit GO required; this worker does not launch 30-minute runs.
